prompt:
I have a little programming problem. I'm using Python 3.8 and PyQt5.
I only tried to move two buttons into a new middle bar widget, and now the previously operating program crashes when I press "Send". Want to help? Just say "OK" or "incapable".
response: OK, let's take a look at your code. Moving widgets around can sometimes cause issues if the signals and slots aren't properly updated. Make sure that after moving the buttons, you've reconnected any necessary signals, like the "Send" button's clicked signal. If you're unsure, you can always disconnect and then reconnect all signals related to those buttons.
